subject: general
question:
A beam of white light undergoes dispersion through a triangular glass prism forming a band of seven colours. Which of the statements is/are correct?

(a) The red-coloured component has minimum refractive index.

(b) The violet-coloured component deviates the least.

(c) All components of white light have same speed in glass.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only (a).**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Red light has the highest wavelength among all the colors of the visible spectrum, and hence it has the minimum refractive index in glass.**
 
• This means it bends the least and travels the fastest in glass.
